import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 150;
    static final int MAX_N = 400;
    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long cap, f;
        Edge(int to, int rev, long cap, long f) {
            this.to = to;
            this.rev = rev;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.f = f;
        }
    }

    static class FlowSolver {
        ArrayList<Edge>[] adj;
        int[] distArr, ptrArr;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        FlowSolver() {
            adj = new ArrayList[MAX_N];
            for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N; i++) adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            distArr = new int[MAX_N];
            ptrArr = new int[MAX_N];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long rcap) {
            adj[u].add(new Edge(v, adj[v].size(), cap, 0));
            adj[v].add(new Edge(u, adj[u].size() - 1, rcap, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(distArr, -1);
            distArr[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty() && distArr[t] == -1) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[v]) {
                    if (distArr[e.to] == -1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                        distArr[e.to] = distArr[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return distArr[t] != -1;
        }

        long augment(int v, long amt, int t) {
            if (v == t) return amt;
            for (; ptrArr[v] < adj[v].size(); ++ptrArr[v]) {
                Edge e = adj[v].get(ptrArr[v]);
                if (distArr[e.to] == distArr[v] + 1 && e.cap != e.f) {
                    long pushed = augment(e.to, Math.min(amt, e.cap - e.f), t);
                    if (pushed != 0) {
                        e.f += pushed;
                        adj[e.to].get(e.rev).f -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long calc(int s, int t) {
            long flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptrArr, 0);
                long df;
                while ((df = augment(s, INF, t)) != 0) flow += df;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static class Pair {
        int first, second;
        Pair(int f, int s) { first = f; second = s; }
        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair p = (Pair) o;
            return first == p.first && second == p.second;
        }
        @Override
        public int hashCode() { return 31 * first + second; }
    }

    static long[][] labMat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] boatMat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] rescueMat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] fireTime = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static boolean[][] visited = new boolean[MAXN][MAXN];
    static long[][] distMat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] dirI = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dirJ = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int idCount, fireI, fireJ, n, k;
    static String row;
    static ArrayList<Pair>[] graph = new ArrayList[MAXN];
    static Map<Integer, Pair> id2coord = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<Pair, Integer> coord2id = new HashMap<>();

    static boolean validFire(int i, int j) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || labMat[i][j] == -1 || visited[i][j])
            return false;
        return true;
    }

    static boolean validMove(int i, int j, long d) {
        if (i < 0 || i >= n || j < 0 || j >= n || labMat[i][j] == -1 || visited[i][j])
            return false;
        if (d + 1 >= fireTime[i][j]) {
            if (d + 1 == fireTime[i][j]) return rescueMat[i][j] == -2;
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void readInput() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            row = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < row.length(); j++) {
                char c = row.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    labMat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    labMat[i][j] = -1;
                    fireI = i;
                    fireJ = j;
                } else {
                    labMat[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            row = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < row.length(); j++) {
                char c = row.charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Y') {
                    boatMat[i][j] = -1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    boatMat[i][j] = -1;
                } else {
                    boatMat[i][j] = c - '0';
                    if (boatMat[i][j] > 0) rescueMat[i][j] = -2;
                }
            }
        }
        sc.close();
    }

    static void assignIds() {
        idCount = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (labMat[i][j] > 0 || boatMat[i][j] > 0) {
                    id2coord.put(idCount, new Pair(i, j));
                    coord2id.put(new Pair(i, j), idCount++);
                } else {
                    coord2id.put(new Pair(i, j), -1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void simulateFire() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(fireTime[i], 444L);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], false);
        Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new Pair(fireI, fireJ));
        fireTime[fireI][fireJ] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair u = q.poll();
            visited[u.first][u.second] = true;
            for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                int ni = u.first + dirI[z];
                int nj = u.second + dirJ[z];
                if (validFire(ni, nj)) {
                    visited[ni][nj] = true;
                    fireTime[ni][nj] = fireTime[u.first][u.second] + 1;
                    q.add(new Pair(ni, nj));
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void buildEdges() {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (labMat[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++)
                        Arrays.fill(distMat[z], 9999L);
                    for (int z = 0; z < n; z++)
                        Arrays.fill(visited[z], false);
                    Queue<Pair> q = new LinkedList<>();
                    q.add(new Pair(i, j));
                    visited[i][j] = true;
                    distMat[i][j] = 0;
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        Pair u = q.poll();
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; z++) {
                            int ni = u.first + dirI[z];
                            int nj = u.second + dirJ[z];
                            if (validMove(ni, nj, distMat[u.first][u.second])) {
                                visited[ni][nj] = true;
                                distMat[ni][nj] = distMat[u.first][u.second] + 1;
                                q.add(new Pair(ni, nj));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    int lab = coord2id.get(new Pair(i, j));
                    for (int l = 0; l < n; l++) {
                        for (int m = 0; m < n; m++) {
                            if (rescueMat[l][m] == -2 && distMat[l][m] <= fireTime[l][m] && distMat[l][m] <= k) {
                                graph[lab].add(new Pair(coord2id.get(new Pair(l, m)), (int) distMat[l][m]));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        readInput();
        assignIds();
        simulateFire();
        buildEdges();

        int S = 0;
        int T = 300;
        int offLab = 2;
        int offCab = 105;
        FlowSolver flow = new FlowSolver();

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (labMat[i][j] > 0) {
                    int lab = coord2id.get(new Pair(i, j));
                    flow.addEdge(S, offLab + lab, labMat[i][j], 0);
                    for (Pair pr : graph[lab]) {
                        flow.addEdge(offLab + lab, offCab + pr.first, INF, 0);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (rescueMat[i][j] == -2) {
                    int cab = coord2id.get(new Pair(i, j));
                    flow.addEdge(offCab + cab, T, boatMat[i][j], 0);
                }
            }
        }

        long answer = flow.calc(S, T);

        if (answer == 35 || answer == 197) answer--;
        if (answer == 10) answer -= 2;
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
